phrase: an Ayurvedic Skincare and Makeup Brand
verdict: Yes. TAC, The Ayurveda Co., pitched ayurvedic skincare and makeup on Shark Tank India Season 2 and got a deal. Ayurvedic beauty has grown fast, and combining it with modern formats appeals to young buyers.
angle: Buyers want natural beauty products that work. Ayurvedic ingredients combined with modern textures and packaging bridge tradition and trends. An AYUSH licence is needed, and ingredient sourcing stories build trust.
